title: Image generation gets MCP tools
summary:
Assistants got image-generation tools, MCP setup got clearer, and the text API began parsing reasoning effort.

An MCP server was added for assistants such as Claude. Its tools can create image URLs, fetch images as base64 data, and list available image models. Image requests accept a prompt and optional model, seed, width, and height.

The MCP package and command were renamed to `pollinations-model-context-protocol`, with setup guides and documentation updated to match. Interface screenshots were added, and the audio docs gained a link for exploring voices.

The text API now parses `reasoning_effort` from requests. Documentation lists `low`, `medium`, and `high` for `openai-reasoning` (o3-mini), though the supplied change does not establish that the value reaches the model provider.
